arXiv:2605.22795v1 [stat.ML] 2026 年 5 月 21 日arXiv:2605.22795v1 [stat.ML] 21 May 2026

保守和非保守漂移模型的有限粒子收敛率Finite-Particle Convergence Rates for Conservative and Non-Conservative Drifting Models

Krishnakumar Balasubramanian
Department of Statistics, University of California, Davis
kbala@ucdavis.edu
摘要Abstract

我们提出并分析了一种用于一步生成建模的保守漂移方法。该方法用核密度估计器（KDE）梯度速度代替原来的基于位移的漂移速度，即核平滑数据得分与核平滑模型得分的差值。该速度是一个梯度场，解决了一般基于位移的漂移场所确定的非保守性问题。我们证明了保守方法的连续时间有限粒子收敛界限We propose and analyze a conservative drifting method for one-step generative modeling. The method replaces the original displacement-based drifting velocity by a kernel density estimator (KDE)-gradient velocity, namely the difference of the kernel-smoothed data score and the kernel-smoothed model score. This velocity is a gradient field, addressing the non-conservatism issue identified for general displacement-based drifting fields. We prove continuous-time finite-particle convergence bounds for the conservative method onℝd\mathbb{R}^{d}：联合熵恒等式产生经验 Stein 漂移、KDE 的平滑 Fisher 差异和平方中心速度的界限。主要的有限粒子校正是倒数 KDE 自相互作用项，我们给出了控制该项的确定性和高概率局部占用条件。我们保持正交常数明确并跟踪它们可能的带宽依赖性：根残余速度率: a joint-entropy identity yields bounds for the empirical Stein drift, the smoothed Fisher discrepancy of the KDE, and the squared center velocity. The main finite-particle correction is a reciprocal-KDE self-interaction term, and we give deterministic and high-probability local-occupancy conditions under which this term is controlled. We keep the quadrature constants explicit and track their possible bandwidth dependence: the root residual-velocity rateN−1/(d+4)N^{-1/(d+4)}持有额外的holds under an additionalhh-统一的正交规则条件，而更一般的生长条件产生优化的根率-uniform quadrature regularity condition, while a more general growth condition yields the optimized root rateN−(2−β)/(2​(d+4−β))N^{-(2-\beta)/(2(d+4-\beta))}, 其中, where0≤β<20\leq\beta<2。我们还分析了带有拉普拉斯核的非保守漂移方法，对应于原始的基于位移的速度. We also analyze the non-conservative drifting method with Laplace kernel, corresponding to the original displacement-based velocity proposed inDeng et al. (2026)。对于该方法，锐伴核将速度分解为锐分数失配加上拉普拉斯尺度失配残差的正标量预处理，产生具有不可避免的残差项的类似有限粒子速率。最后，我们解释连续时间残余速度界限如何通过显式漂移大小转化为一步生成保证. For this method, a sharp companion kernel decomposes the velocity into a positive scalar preconditioning of a sharp-score mismatch plus a Laplace scale-mismatch residual, producing an analogous finite-particle rate with an unavoidable residual term. Finally, we explain how the continuous-time residual-velocity bounds translate into one-step generation guarantees through the explicit drift sizeη\eta.

1.1 相关工作Related Work

漂移模型是由Drifting models were introduced byDeng et al. (2026)作为一步生成的训练时传输范例：生成的样本通过数据吸引和模型排斥的漂移场重复移动，并且生成器经过训练以通过停止梯度目标再现漂移样本。该观点还与隐式生成建模的分数差流相关，其中速度被写为目标分数和源分数之间的差异as a training-time transport paradigm for one-step generation: generated samples are repeatedly moved by a data-attractive and model-repulsive drift field, and the generator is trained to reproduce the drifted samples through a stop-gradient target. This viewpoint is also related to score-difference flows for implicit generative modeling, where the velocity is written as the difference between target and source scores(Weber, 2023)。随后的工作将漂移与分数匹配和平滑散度的 Wasserstein 梯度流（在无限粒子设置中）联系起来，特别是在高斯核情况下，其中位移场可以写为 KDE 对数密度梯度的差. Subsequent work has connected drifting to score matching and Wasserstein gradient flows of smoothed divergences (in the infinite-particle setting), especially in the Gaussian-kernel case where the displacement field can be written as a difference of KDE log-density gradients(Cao et al., 2026; Lai et al., 2026; Turan and Ovsjanikov, 2026; Gretton et al., 2026).

互补的工作强调了原始基于位移的场的非保守性质。A complementary line of work emphasizes the non-conservative nature of the original displacement-based field.Franz et al. (2026)表明原始场中位置相关的归一化通常会破坏保守性，高斯核是场保持梯度场的特殊情况；他们还引入了尖锐的标准化，以恢复更广泛的径向内核的保守性。show that the position-dependent normalization in the original field generally destroys conservatism, with the Gaussian kernel being a special case where the field remains a gradient field; they also introduce sharp normalizations that restore conservatism for broader radial kernels.Lee and Chun (2026)研究了伴椭圆核家族（包括拉普拉斯核）的可识别性和稳定性，表明消失漂移可以在适当的核结构下识别目标，同时也强调可能的不稳定模式。这些工作促使我们区分基于 KDE 分数梯度的保守漂移方法和基于 KDE 分数梯度的非保守漂移方法studies identifiability and stability for companion-elliptic kernel families, including the Laplace kernel, showing that vanishing drift can identify the target under appropriate kernel structure while also highlighting possible instability modes. These works motivate our distinction between the conservative drifting method, based on KDE-score gradients, and the non-conservative drifting method byDeng et al. (2026)，基于原始位移速度。对于后者，我们的分析表明，有限粒子速率需要尺度对齐残差来测量拉普拉斯位移场是否是精确的分数差场。, based on the original displacement velocity. For the latter, our analysis shows that finite-particle rates require a scale-alignment residual measuring the failure of the Laplace displacement field to be an exact score-difference field.

最近与漂移相关的工作研究了互补的算法和变分观点。Recent drifting-related works study complementary algorithmic and variational perspectives.Dumont et al. (2026)研究通过约束漂移模型学习 Monge 图：它们将发散（例如相对熵）提升到传输图的空间，将动态限制在一组最优传输图上，并证明在凸性假设下对 OT 图的长期存在和收敛。study learning Monge maps through constrained drifting models: they lift a divergence, such as relative entropy, to the space of transport maps, constrain the dynamics to the set of optimal transport maps, and prove long-time existence and convergence toward the OT map under convexity assumptions.He et al. (2026a)引入 Sinkhorn 漂移生成模型，表明漂移的吸引-排斥结构可以被视为 Sinkhorn 发散梯度流的单侧替代，而两侧 Sinkhorn 缩放可以提高可识别性和稳定性。introduce Sinkhorn-Drifting Generative Models, showing that the attraction–repulsion structure of drifting can be viewed as a one-sided surrogate for a Sinkhorn-divergence gradient flow, while two-sided Sinkhorn scaling gives improved identifiability and stability.Zhang et al. (2026)提出了前瞻漂移模型，该模型在每次训练迭代中计算多个连续漂移项，并回归到这些项的加权和，其目标是在保留单步推理的同时合并高阶漂移信息。propose Lookahead Drifting Models, which compute several sequential drift terms within each training iteration and regress toward a weighted sum of these terms, with the goal of incorporating higher-order drift information while preserving one-step inference.

更广泛地说，现代生成模型通常围绕学习的传输动力学进行组织。扩散和基于分数的模型学习逆时降噪动力学并通过数值求解 SDE 或概率流 ODE 来生成样本More broadly, modern generative modeling is often organized around learned transport dynamics. Diffusion and score-based models learn reverse-time denoising dynamics and generate samples by numerically solving an SDE or probability-flow ODE(Ho et al., 2020; Song et al., 2021)，而流匹配和校正流学习依赖于时间的向量场，这些向量场沿着规定的概率路径将基本分布传输到数据分布, while flow matching and rectified flow learn time-dependent vector fields that transport a base distribution to the data distribution along prescribed probability paths(Albergo and Vanden-Eijnden, 2023; Lipman et al., 2023; Liu et al., 2023)。相反，基于流程图和蒸馏的方法尝试学习较长时间的解决方案运算符，或将许多求解器步骤压缩为一个或几个神经评估，如流程图匹配、一致性模型和渐进式蒸馏. Flow-map and distillation-based approaches instead try to learn longer-time solution operators, or compress many solver steps into one or a few neural evaluations, as in flow-map matching, consistency models, and progressive distillation(Boffi et al., 2025; Song et al., 2023; Salimans and Ho, 2022)。从这个角度来看，漂移模型可以解释为将推理时间传输计算的一部分转移到训练中：长短流图视角. From this viewpoint, drifting models can be interpreted as moving part of the inference-time transport computation into training: the long-short flow-map perspective ofLi and Zhu (2026)将全局传输分解为长时域图，然后进行短终端校正，并在消失终端间隔的极限内恢复漂移场。decomposes a global transport into a long-horizon map followed by a short terminal correction, and recovers the drifting field in the limit of a vanishing terminal interval.

所提出的保守速度方法也与基于斯坦因差异的确定性相互作用粒子方法密切相关。 Stein 变分梯度下降 (SVGD) 是由The proposed conservative velocity approach is also closely related to deterministic interacting-particle methods based on Stein discrepancies. Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD) was introduced byLiu and Wang (2016)作为近似贝叶斯推理的确定性粒子方法，以及as a deterministic particle method for approximate Bayesian inference, andLiu (2017)将其种群限制解释为斯坦因诱导几何下 KL 散度的梯度流。摊销SVGDinterpreted its population limit as a gradient flow of KL divergence under a Stein-induced geometry. Amortized SVGD(Feng et al., 2017)训练采样器网络来重现 SVGD 粒子更新，这在概念上接近于漂移的停止梯度回归视图。在有限粒子分析层面，trains a sampler network to reproduce SVGD particle updates, which is conceptually close to the stop-gradient regression view of drifting. At the level of finite-particle analysis,Banerjee et al. (2025)通过区分粒子定律相对于产品目标的联合熵，获得改进的 SVGD 率，通过以下方式改进早期结果obtain improved SVGD rates by differentiating the joint entropy of the particle law relative to the product target, improving upon earlier results byShi and Mackey (2023)。研究了扩展到正则化设置. Extension to a regularized setting was studied byHe et al. (2026b)。我们在证明中利用并扩展了这种高级熵耗散策略，但受控量和误差项是特定于漂移的：对于保守漂移，受控量是均方保守残差，具有倒数 KDE 自交互作用和. We leverage and extend this high-level entropy-dissipation strategy in our proofs, but the controlled quantities and error terms are specific to drifting: for conservative drifting, the controlled quantity is the mean squared conservative residual with a reciprocal-KDE self-interaction and anhh- 相关正交误差；对于非保守拉普拉斯方法，该速率还包含拉普拉斯尺度失配残差。-dependent quadrature error; for the non-conservative Laplace method, the rate additionally contains the Laplace scale-mismatch residual.

即将出现的结果的另一个有用的特征是，它仅强加上述的局部平滑度和 定义其分数所需的平滑目标密度的积极假设 并证明熵计算的合理性；特别是，我们不假设曲率条件，例如 目标是对数凹、强对数凹或满足 Log-Sobolev， 庞加莱，或耗散条件。我们控制的界限 时间平均残余漂移，提供全局收敛 在这种附加曲率条件下的 KL 或 Wasserstein 距离。Another useful feature of the forthcoming results is that it imposes only the aforementioned local smoothness and positivity assumptions on the smoothed target density needed to define its score and justify the entropy calculation; in particular, we do not assume curvature conditions such as the target is log-concave, strongly log-concave, or satisfies a Log-Sobolev, Poincaré, or dissipativity condition. Our bounds that control the time-averaged residual drift, provide a global convergence in KL or Wasserstein distance under such additional curvature conditions.

6 使用拉普拉斯核的非保守漂移方法的有限粒子速率Finite-particle rates for the non-conservative drifting method with Laplace kernel

我们现在用拉普拉斯核证明基于非保守位移的漂移场的连续时间有限粒子速率。主要的一点是，与高斯核不同，拉普拉斯均值漂移场并不完全是一个分数差场。尽管如此，它承认一种有用的“锐分数”表示，它产生带有附加尺度失配残差的有限粒子收敛定理。本节中使用的尖锐伴核结构遵循 锐标准化框架We now prove a continuous-time finite-particle rate for the non-conservative displacement-based drifting field with Laplace kernel. The main point is that, unlike the Gaussian kernel, the Laplace mean-shift field is not exactly a score-difference field. Nevertheless, it admits a useful “sharp-score” representation, which yields a finite-particle convergence theorem with an additional scale-mismatch residual. The sharp companion kernel construction used in this section follows the sharp-normalization framework ofFranz et al. (2026)，专门针对 拉普拉斯核。我们对它的使用是不同的：而不是替换原来的 通过锐标准化进行拉普拉斯标准化，我们使用锐核来 将原始非保守拉普拉斯场分解为预处理 锐分数不匹配加上尺度不匹配残差。, specialized to the Laplace kernel. Our use of it is different: rather than replacing the original Laplace normalization by the sharp normalization, we use the sharp kernel to decompose the original non-conservative Laplace field into a preconditioned sharp-score mismatch plus a scale-mismatch residual.

在本节中，让Throughout this section, let

Kh​(u):=cd​h−d​exp⁡(−‖u‖h),u∈ℝd,K_{h}(u):=c_{d}h^{-d}\exp\!\left(-\frac{\left\lVert u\right\rVert}{h}\right),\qquad u\in\mathbb{R}^{d},

哪里wherecd>0c_{d}>0被选择使得is chosen so that∫ℝdKh​(u)​du=1\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d}}K_{h}(u)\,\mathrm{d}u=1。对于概率测度. For a probability measureα\alpha on ℝd\mathbb{R}^{d}，定义其拉普拉斯KDE, define its Laplace KDE

Qα,h​(z):=∫ℝdKh​(z−y)​α​(d​y),Q_{\alpha,h}(z):=\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d}}K_{h}(z-y)\,\alpha(\,\mathrm{d}y),

和非保守位移均值平移向量and the non-conservative displacement mean-shift vector

Mα,h​(z):=∫ℝd(y−z)​Kh​(z−y)​α​(d​y)Qα,h​(z).M_{\alpha,h}(z):=\frac{\int_{\mathbb{R}^{d}}(y-z)K_{h}(z-y)\,\alpha(\,\mathrm{d}y)}{Q_{\alpha,h}(z)}.

我们分析非保守拉普拉斯漂移场的自掩蔽或留一有限粒子版本。对于每个We analyze the self-masked, or leave-one-out, finite-particle version of the non-conservative Laplace drifting field. For eachii, 定义, define

For the non-conservative Laplace method, the drift decomposes as

这种差异不是证明的产物。它体现了身份This difference is not an artifact of the proof. It reflects the identity

这是非保守拉普拉斯位移场可能与分数不匹配相关的结构原因。在高斯情况下，非保守位移场只是保守场的常数倍；在拉普拉斯情况下，它是一个可变尺度的预处理锐分数场加上残差which is the structural reason the non-conservative Laplace displacement field can be related to a score mismatch at all. In the Gaussian case, the non-conservative displacement field is simply a constant multiple of the conservative field; in the Laplace case, it is instead a variable-scale preconditioned sharp-score field plus the residualexe_{x}.
